slt_definition.phase_order: QS -> GI -> SSSW -> SLT -> SSLW -> GT
slt_definition.start: the selected load-peak boundary after SSSW
slt_definition.end: the next selected load-peak boundary before SSLW
slt_definition.mechanism: the segmentation code assigns SLT to peaks[k] through peaks[k+1], one transition interval selected by a trial-wide two-regime cycle-feature fit
slt_definition.status: model-assisted provisional; load peaks are candidate landmarks, not verified heel-strike or ground-truth cycle labels

cycle_grouping.stored_structure: one selected SLT transition interval per physical window, copied to its left and right limb-specific trace
cycle_grouping.reason: SLT itself is the single selected transition interval. It does not contain a stored five-cycle/repetition structure, and splitting it further would create artificial repetitions.
